calls.reason: The EBU/BBC study in late 2025 found significant issues in 45% of answers from leading assistants, 20% with major accuracy errors. Deloitte's AI-fabricated government report led to a partial refund.
A 2025 CEPA study found few countries copying the EU AI Act, while major economies chose lighter rules. The EU itself proposed delaying its high-risk rules. Vietnam's law is a lone counterexample.
Amazon's planned October 2024 launch of an LLM-powered Alexa slipped into 2025 over hallucination problems. Gemini Live did ship, but nothing shows it markedly improved the assistant.

OpenAI expected about a $5B loss in 2024. Inflection, Adept and Covariant investors got back their money or little more in license-and-hire deals. Character.AI's 2.5x buyout is an extra case outside the 'at least three'.
The Census data shows low business AI use but says nothing about what people expected. A single OpenAI loss forecast does not give an industry-wide profit total.

Baidu reports fully driverless service across many Chinese cities at over 250,000 weekly rides, which undercuts 'mainly in the West'. Trucking jobs support the human-driver part. Overall the evidence is mixed.
